_note: no_walkaway: phases you cannot abandon or pause out of. At CLOSEOUT nothing is left to decide, only steps to finish — so the closeout's gates cannot be dodged by relabelling the exit.

FREE._note: No pipeline at all, on the record. Entered from CLASSIFY like any other tier and left to IDLE, so both ends are history entries with a timestamp and a reason. Nothing is gated here — that is the point — and what stays enforced is DAW itself: the method, the journal and the state are as sealed in FREE as anywhere else. FREE turns the pipeline off; it does not hand over the thing that would turn it off for good.

_resume_note: Resuming a paused ticket re-enters the phase it was paused in. There is no list of resumable phases: the proof is the pause itself. The entry before the resume must be a `pause:` ending at IDLE, and the phase it paused FROM is the only one the resume may re-enter. A list would have been a second, weaker way to say the same thing — and one more place to forget to update.
_backward_note: Backward edges carry `clears`: the gates the forward edge granted, which going back takes away. The validator REFUSES a backward transition whose new state still holds them — clearing them in the helper alone would leave a hand-written state able to step back, keep the gates and step forward without re-earning anything, which is how a rewritten artifact used to be laundered through the corrective loop.
